subject: Advanced visibility add-ons — pricing grid and savings scenarios
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasai.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlasai.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Advanced visibility add-ons — pricing grid and savings scenarios

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran a quick check with our infra and want to understand the economics for your visibility add-ons (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards). Two asks: 

1) Can you provide a simple pricing grid that shows cost delta for 90 / 365 day retention + tracing enabled vs tracing disabled (per TB ingested or per event)?
2) Do you offer commit-based discounts or pilot credits for POC customers? If so, what are the standard breakpoints you recommend for a mid-market SaaS like Atlas (we're ~600GB/day ingest today)?

If useful, I can share a sample ingestion profile. We're aiming to present a short list to procurement by next week. Also happy to do a 30-minute call with your pricing lead.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Platform Engineering, Atlas AI
[jordan.ellis@atlasai.com]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Advanced visibility add-ons — pricing grid and savings scenarios

Hi Jordan — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful. Short answers up front: yes, we can produce the grid and yes, we typically offer commit discounts plus pilot/demo credits for evaluation.

Next steps I propose:
- If you can share the ingest profile (sample of events by size and retention percentiles) we'll run a 90/365 cost delta and a tracing-enabled vs tracing-disabled scenario.
- I'll attach a starter pricing worksheet (visibility_pricing_grid_v1.xlsx) with our standard per-GB and per-trace-event line items; we can customize the breakpoints.
- For POC customers we commonly provide a one-time pilot credit (we suggested 10–20% consumption credit depending on scope) and a managed onboarding package.

I'll loop Ben (cc'd) — he can weigh in on commercial breakpoints (pilot vs annual commit tiers). If it helps, we can schedule a short call Tue/Wed.

Attached: visibility_pricing_grid_v1.xlsx (pricing worksheet)

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Advanced visibility add-ons — pricing grid and savings scenarios

Stephanie — quick internal note after reviewing Jordan's ask and the worksheet:

On Sun, May 3, 2026 at 11:05 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful.

Key commercial thoughts:
- For a ~600GB/day ingest profile, retention is the dominant cost lever. Our standard public rate is $0.18/GB-month for active retention (90d), $0.12/GB-month for annual archiving (365d) when committed.
- Tracing adds marginal CPU/KV cache pressure; we price tracing events at $0.002 per 1000 spans (baseline), with a usage band discount at 10TB/month and again at 50TB/month.
- Pilot credit: propose 15% consumption credit for a 90-day POC (to cover onboarding + evaluation).
- Commit breakpoints (recommended): annual commit >= $120k ARR (15% off list), >= $300k ARR (25% off list) + 90d guaranteed retention SLA.

Action: Kimberly — can you run a quick model showing Atlas at baseline (no commit) / 12-month commit @120k / 12-month commit @300k and include projected monthly invoices and a one-line SOW discount? Jordan asked for breakpoints he can share with procurement.

Ben
VP, Commercials
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@atlasai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlasai.com>, procurement@atlasai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Atlas AI — visibility add-ons commercial proposal and next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya — thanks for the ingest profile you shared this week. Attached is a short commercial proposal that maps the scenarios Ben outlined to Atlas' numbers: baseline (pay-as-you-go), 12-month commit (approx $140k ARR) and 12-month commit (approx $325k ARR).

Key points from the proposal:
- We applied a 15% pilot credit to the POC for the first 90 days (consumption credit applied to visibility add-ons only).
- Commit discounts: 15% at $120k ARR, 25% at $300k ARR (applies to visibility list prices, excludes third-party cloud egress).
- Retention options are shown side-by-side (90d active vs 365d cold) with the monthly delta and an estimated annual TCO.
- Tracing: default per-span pricing with a 10TB/month band discount called out; dashboards are a fixed-fee module with seat-based add-ons called out in Appendix A.

Attachments: proposal_AtlasAI_v1.pdf, SOW_AtlasAI_draft.docx

Next steps suggested:
1) You review with procurement and let me know which commit band you'd like modeled as a redlineable SOW.
2) If procurement is comfortable we can kick off a 90-day pilot with the pilot credit; onboarding slots available week of May 18.
3) I'll open a DocuSign envelope for the SOW once you confirm scope.

If you want a quick walk-through of the proposal with Ben and Kimberly on the call, I'm available Fri 10–12 PT.

Thanks and happy to iterate — Stephanie
